origin.basis: Bontrager is Trek Bicycle Corporation's component brand (Trek US store footer).

manufacturing.basis: The Trek product page does not state where the tire is made.

availability.note: Sold by Trek's US web store; Trek stores and dealers in other regions were not checked for this tire.

name: Kwaremont RSL TLR
positioning: High-volume 320 TPI cotton road tire combining race speed with comfort on rough roads.
hookless_note: Trek says it is compatible with hooked and hookless rims and that maximum pressures vary by size and rim type.
caveats: Check the rim maker for hookless pressure limits.

price_observations.conditions: Official store price on 2026-11-01; one tire; shipping and tax at checkout.
